name: CryptoCompare
summary: Crypto market data from CryptoCompare, now CoinDesk Data: reference index and exchange prices, OHLCV history, asset profiles and rankings, and crypto news.

api_key.description: A CoinDesk Data (formerly CryptoCompare) API key from developers.coindesk.com. Sent as the api_key query parameter; some endpoints work without one.

notes: This is the Data API (data-api.cryptocompare.com, also served at data-api.coindesk.com); the older min-api endpoints are not in this entry.
Pairs are written BASE-QUOTE (BTC-USD). Index endpoints take an index family as market (cadli by default); spot endpoints take an exchange.
List-valued inputs (instruments, assets, groups, categories) are comma-separated strings.
Rate limits apply per second, minute, hour, day and month; going over returns 429.

endpoints.name: Get the latest index price for crypto pairs
endpoints.summary: Current index value (default CADLI) with OHLC and change over several windows, for one or more pairs.

market.description: Index family, e.g. cadli (24-hour volume-weighted reference index), ccix.

groups.description: Comma-separated field groups to return; empty returns all.

endpoints.name: Get daily index candles for a pair
endpoints.summary: Daily open, high, low, close and volume of an index instrument.

to_ts.description: Last point's Unix time (seconds), inclusive; for paging backwards.

aggregate.description: Points merged into each returned candle, 1-30; default 1.

fill.description: false skips periods without trading; default true.

groups.description: Comma-separated field groups to return; empty returns all.

notes: Page backwards with to_ts: the oldest timestamp of one batch comes back again as the newest of the next, so step it back by one interval (86400 s daily, 3600 s hourly).

endpoints.name: Get hourly index candles for a pair
endpoints.summary: Hourly open, high, low, close and volume of an index instrument.

to_ts.description: Last point's Unix time (seconds), inclusive; for paging backwards.

aggregate.description: Points merged into each returned candle, 1-30; default 1.

fill.description: false skips periods without trading; default true.

groups.description: Comma-separated field groups to return; empty returns all.

notes: Page backwards with to_ts: the oldest timestamp of one batch comes back again as the newest of the next, so step it back by one interval (86400 s daily, 3600 s hourly).

endpoints.name: Get the latest price on one exchange
endpoints.summary: Latest trade price and rolling volume and OHLC for pairs on one exchange.

instruments.description: Comma-separated pairs, mapped (BTC-USD) or as the exchange names them (XXBTZUSD).

groups.description: Comma-separated field groups to return; empty returns all.

endpoints.name: Get daily candles for a pair on one exchange
endpoints.summary: Daily OHLC and base/quote volume of one exchange instrument.

instrument.description: One pair, mapped (BTC-USD) or as the exchange names it.

to_ts.description: Last point's Unix time (seconds), inclusive; for paging backwards.

aggregate.description: Points merged into each returned candle, 1-30; default 1.

fill.description: false skips periods without trading; default true.

groups.description: Comma-separated field groups to return; empty returns all.

notes: Page backwards with to_ts: the oldest timestamp of one batch comes back again as the newest of the next, so step it back by one interval (86400 s daily, 3600 s hourly).

endpoints.name: Get asset profiles
endpoints.summary: Description, classification, supply, price, market cap and links for one or more assets.

assets.description: Comma-separated asset symbols or CoinDesk asset IDs.

asset_lookup_priority.description: What assets holds: SYMBOL (default), ID or URI.

quote_asset.description: Currency for price and market cap values; default USD.

groups.description: Comma-separated field groups to return; empty returns all.

endpoints.name: Rank crypto assets
endpoints.summary: Assets ranked by market cap, volume, price or change, page by page.

sort_by.description: Field to rank by, e.g. CIRCULATING_MKT_CAP_USD (default), TOTAL_MKT_CAP_USD, PRICE_USD.

toplist_quote_asset.description: Quote asset for values; default USD.

asset_type.description: Only this asset type, e.g. BLOCKCHAIN or TOKEN; empty for all.

endpoints.name: Search crypto assets
endpoints.summary: Assets matching a symbol, name or ID.

search_string.description: Text matched against the start of symbols and anywhere in names; a number matches asset IDs.

endpoints.name: List the latest crypto news articles
endpoints.summary: Newest articles from crypto news sources, filtered by language, source and category.

lang.description: EN (default), ES, TR, FR, JP or PT.

source_ids.description: Comma-separated source keys; empty for every active source.

to_ts.description: Only articles published at or before this Unix time.

endpoints.name: Check the key's rate limit
endpoints.summary: Current usage against the key's rate limits.
notes: Needs an API key, and the call itself counts against the limit; the X-RateLimit-* headers returned on responses give the same without a call.
